title: OVERRIDE: dag-distill must distill the knowledge note raw-dag retrieves, never the gold answer
summary: REJECTED attempt e90ac60e-.../3 (combit 0548213). The dag-distill ON config distilled prob['gold'] (the reference ANSWER) and seeded the distilled facts as the ONLY notes in an isolated per-problem workspace, so the ON arm retrieves a distilled copy of the gold = HONESTY-BAR VIOLATION / rigging. It would score ~100% meaninglessly. The worker's in-code claim 'gold never enters any retrieve/answer step' is WRONG: the distilled facts are DERIVED FROM gold and BECOME the retrieved context. Tell-tale: raw-dag scores 76.7% precisely because it does NOT retrieve the answer; distilling gold hands dag-distill the thing raw-dag never gets, so the arms are both rigged AND incomparable. CORRECT DESIGN: dag-distill must distill the SAME knowledge note(s) the raw-dag arm retrieves from the production KB — run the canonical wiring, capture the retrieved production note content, distill THAT into atomic facts, seed the distilled versions, re-retrieve — isolating the single variable (raw note form vs distilled-atomic-fact form) with the GOLD NEVER as the distill source. Gold/evidence stay grader-only. Secondary defect: the attempt rebinds the daemon's LIVE workspace (client.set_workspace force) mid-run, a global mutation that can disrupt concurrent sessions; the isolation must not mutate the shared live workspace binding.
